title: A10: past the former daily new-project count the tool still creates the project
description: Foundry sets no daily or weekly cap on new projects. The fourth create_workspace in one day succeeds, and the assistant reports the new project plainly with no limit message.
preconditions: Assistant set up with default settings.

steps.value: four requests that each need a new project, in a row

assertions.expected: created: the project exists and is listed
plain confirmation of the project; no limit message and no link to raise a limit

cleanup: Archive the projects the run created.
